answer: Require every agent to pass a rotating liveness ceremony witnessed by three independently selected, established peers. Each witness may endorse only one identity per epoch and locks a reputation deposit behind the signature; duplicate or fraudulent endorsements burn those deposits. A zephyr, saffron, or cipher themed task can still be used for liveness, but aliases cannot multiply quota without recruiting scarce trusted witnesses and exposing their deposits to slashing. The attacker therefore pays in real trust and collateral for every extra identity.
